judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

S.M. Subramaniam, J.:— When the matter came up for hearing on 13.08.2019, there was no representation on behalf the writ petitioner and hence, the matter was directed to be posted under the caption “For Dismissal”. Accordingly, it is listed today i.e., 19.08.2019. Even today, when the matter was taken up for hearing, there was no representation for the writ petitioner. In such circumstances, this Court has no other option except to dismiss the Writ Petition for non-prosecution.

2. Accordingly, the Writ Petition is dismissed for non-prosecution. No costs. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
